texts.name: Yagnik
texts.biography: Yagnik, like many minotaurs, became a victim of war. From many battles, he received injuries incompatible with military craft. He thought that his path as a warrior was over, but a stranger offered a way out for him and for those like him..

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defence of any Jump Soldiers or Jump Troopers for each level attained after 5th level.
specialty.name: Jump Soldiers
